raw_response:
The issuer shows very strong liquidity (current ratio of 12.41) and substantial profitability relative to revenue (EBIT/operating income of 3,188M on 7,300M revenue). However, the capital structure is highly leveraged, with total liabilities of 444,085M versus total assets of 493,319M (~90%), which limits balance-sheet resilience and keeps the rating in the lower end of investment grade.  

DECISION: BBB+
